verdict.rationale: ROS 2 lets nodes communicate over standardized topic/service interfaces meant for streams such as sensor data. Community users describe its shared message types as an agreed contract across libraries and drivers. Static name remapping and runtime composition let a driver node be swapped without touching consumers, but this decoupling comes from messaging conventions, not a documented hardware-abstraction layer for sensors and actuators. Missing for 10: an explicit hardware-abstraction/driver-interface framework (e.g. an actuator control interface), docs showing a sensor or actuator swap without code changes, and hands-on corroboration of such a swap.
